hard_guards: Do not import assumptions or resources from other projects.
Stable is owner-gated: no deploy, public traffic, promotion, real-user bootstrap, Stable OAuth refresh token activation, or Stable release without explicit Owner command.
Never commit or log secrets, passwords, private keys, refresh tokens, signing material, or session/access tokens.
Do not reopen Office fallback/provider research unless Owner explicitly reopens the requirement.
Do not add location/bin inventory management; scope is SKU plus product name.
Do not copy Beta runtime data into Stable.
For finite deploy/build/test jobs: trigger, poll, inspect failure, repair within scope, rerun, and continue until terminal PASS or an Owner-only blocker.
owner_accepted_business_rules: Roles: PICKER, REPORTER, ADMIN, ROOT.
Picker reports out-of-stock SKU; unresolved dedupe is Picker + SKU.
Multiple Pickers reporting the same SKU share one processing batch while retaining separate report tickets.
Reporter priority: higher affected Picker count first; tie-breaker is earlier first_report_at.
Picker may withdraw an unresolved mistaken report within 60 seconds, enforced by server time.
Resolution values are HAS_STOCK and SKIP_ALLOWED.
SKIP_ALLOWED may be corrected to HAS_STOCK within 5 minutes, enforced by server time.
Report ticket, processing batch, and lifecycle event are separate concepts and records.
Operational authority is Worker + InventoryCore SQLite; Google Sheets is not a competing primary transaction store.
HR source is configured by Admin/Root using Google Sheet URL, exact tab name, configurable Mã nhân viên column and configurable Họ và tên column, saved only after backend validation.
ROOT inherits all Admin and Reporter capabilities and may create/manage Admin and Reporter plus manage Picker lifecycle; Admin may create/manage Reporter and manage Picker lifecycle.

Managed Admin/Reporter passwords are set directly by authorized managers; Picker provisioning uses the protected runtime default password and legacy uninitialized Picker accounts initialize from that same protected default on first login.
HR sync does not automatically disable/delete absent Pickers or reactivate deliberately disabled Pickers; Admin/Root explicitly open, disable or delete one, many or all Picker accounts.
Practical Balanced / Phương án 1 is the active UI direction, prioritizing Picker/Reporter SKU/report work and using explicit business labels, relevant icons and consistent typography.
Android/PDA Beta must verify it is the latest valid signed Beta version before login; an older or unverifiable build cannot log in.

Android/PDA UI is narrow-screen-first, removes non-operational explanatory/design-discussion text, uses a full-brand adaptive launcher icon without an added white wrapper, and uses the shorter Android product credit.

Android/PDA approved operational layout uses compact BÁO HÀNG 1291 identity/header; Picker uses one-row SKU entry plus BÁO HẾT HÀNG and today status cards; Reporter uses four state filters and equal CÓ HÀNG / CHO SKIP HÀNG actions, with Picker thu hồi backed by real CLOSED withdrawal batches.
Detailed operational retention target is about 60 days; unresolved items survive retention until resolved; long-term archive is batched to Drive/Sheets.
Foreground realtime uses WebSocket; background notification uses FCM; client reload is not synchronization logic.

SKU Excel imports support 10,000-50,000 rows, use bounded idempotent chunks, merge identical duplicate rows, require an explicit choice for conflicting names inside the file, retain old SKUs absent from a later file, and require confirmation before renaming an existing SKU.
Web and Android must expose usable role-specific business workflows; login/settings-only skeletons are not an acceptable finished product.
